title: Functional characterization of UHRF1 variants in facilitating DNA methylation.
authors: Liu, Bigang; Nayvelt, Kaila; Hardikar, Swanand; Kondo, Kimie; Estecio, Marcos R; Cheng, Xiaodong; Chen, Taiping
one_liner_zh: 该文通过小鼠胚胎干细胞功能实验结合AlphaFold3结构预测，表征UHRF1变体对DNA甲基化维持的影响，涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，方法含结构预测但以功能实验为主。
abstract: Ubiquitin-like with plant homeodomain (PHD) and really interesting new gene (RING) finger domains 1 (UHRF1) is essential for DNA methylation inheritance. However, the functional impacts of several natural and engineered UHRF1 variants are either insufficiently characterized or obscured by conflicting results, with some discrepancies likely stemming from cellular toxicity and adaptive responses induced by DNA methylation changes. In this study, we utilized mouse embryonic stem cells (mESCs)-which uniquely tolerate the complete loss of DNA methylation-to evaluate the functional consequences of clinical mutations, isoform variation, and epitope tagging. Using rescue experiments in Uhrf1-deficient mESCs, we characterized two UHRF1 mutations identified in a patient with immunodeficiency, centromeric instability, and facial anomalies (ICF) syndrome, demonstrating that the R618X nonsense mutation creates a null allele, while the R296W missense mutation is hypomorphic. Furthermore, we confirmed that N-terminal tagging abolishes UHRF1 function, whereas human UHRF1 (hUHRF1) isoform 2, featuring a 13-residue N-terminal extension, is functionally inactive. AlphaFold3 structural predictions suggest that these additional residues at the N terminus disrupt essential inter-domain interactions. Collectively, our results define the activity of UHRF1 variants and resolve existing inconsistencies in the field.
abstract_zh: 含植物同源结构域（PHD）和真正感兴趣的新基因（RING）指状结构域的泛素样蛋白1（UHRF1）对于DNA甲基化遗传至关重要。然而，若干天然和工程改造的UHRF1变体的功能影响要么表征不足，要么因相互矛盾的结果而模糊不清，其中一些差异可能源于DNA甲基化变化诱导的细胞毒性和适应性反应。在本研究中，我们利用小鼠胚胎干细胞（mESCs）——其独特地耐受DNA甲基化的完全缺失——来评估临床突变、异构体变异和表位标记的功能后果。通过在Uhrf1缺陷的mESCs中进行拯救实验，我们表征了在一名患有免疫缺陷、着丝粒不稳定和面部异常（ICF）综合征的患者中鉴定出的两种UHRF1突变，证明R618X无义突变产生无效等位基因，而R296W错义突变是亚效等位基因。此外，我们确认N端标记会消除UHRF1功能，而具有13个残基N端延伸的人类UHRF1（hUHRF1）异构体2在功能上无活性。AlphaFold3结构预测表明，这些N端的额外残基破坏了关键的域间相互作用。总体而言，我们的结果定义了UHRF1变体的活性，并解决了该领域中现有的不一致性。
